segments.text: The new Microsoft Copilot is now ready in Business Central, and you can ask all kinds of questions about your own business data, and also any knowledge out there on the internet.
It's the same powerful Microsoft Copilot chat experience you may have seen elsewhere across Microsoft products. Select the Copilot button and type your question.
Ask, for example, for your most urgent sales orders. You can view the data side by side with the response. Copilot searches all your Business Central data, including your customizations,

and you can keep the conversation going. Say the top order is from Adatum. Ask for their top five most purchased items. Copilot continues the conversation, so you can follow along without starting over.
Copilot works within your own permissions, your company, and your context. It only sees what you are allowed to see. What would be your first question?
